题材是年代文：1979 年盛夏，现代社畜猝死穿越，附身北京什刹海一个寄居二叔檐下: The genre is period fiction: high summer, 1979. A modern-day office drone drops dead and wakes as an orphan lodging under his second uncle's roof by Beijing's Shichahai lake. Outline, chapter beat sheet and character notes were identical for everyone; each model generated three chapters independently, with no sight of the others. All 91 reviewer ratings were double-blind — the people scoring saw only a four-digit random code, never the model behind it.

评分方法和适用范围。: How the scoring worked, and how far it reaches.
测评员只看到匿名编号，模型名称、他人评分和评审进度均隐藏。编号与模型的对应关系只: Reviewers saw an anonymous code only — model names, other people's scores and review progress were all hidden. The code-to-model mapping lived only on the admin side.
各评分列单独判断。分数同时满足「偏离该篇中位数超过 2.5 × MAD」和「偏离: Each score column is judged on its own. A score is dropped only when it is both more than 2.5 × MAD from the entry's median and more than 2 points away. This issue, 21 entries triggered the rule for 53 removals in all; one further entry went to re-review.
每位测评员的评分都做内部一致性检验，判别力不足的整批排除。本次排除 8 份。: Every reviewer's scores were checked for internal consistency; sets showing no discriminating power were excluded wholesale. Eight were excluded this time.
每个模型生成 3 篇，每篇有 3 至 4 份评分，共 91 份。专家组补齐了评分: Three chapters per model, 3 — 4 ratings per chapter, 91 in all. The expert panel topped up entries that were short of ratings.
每个模型仅 3 篇。DeepSeek V4 Pro（极差 4.50）、Qwen3: Three chapters per model. For volatile models like DeepSeek V4 Pro (range 4.50) and Qwen3.8 Max (2.75), the mean is of limited use — the consistency dot plot is a better guide than the rank.
维度结论不宜单独引用: Don't quote a single axis on its own
部分维度的评分区分度不足，单项结果要谨慎使用。总分单独统计。: Some axes show little separation in their scores, so use single-axis results with care. The overall score is counted separately.
本次只测开篇，实际平均 4,628 字。长篇节奏、伏笔回收和人物弧光不在评估范围: Only openings were tested — 4,628 characters on average. Book-length pacing, paying off setups and character arcs are outside the scope.
「AI 感」主观性最强: “AI tells” is the most subjective axis
测评员对 AI 痕迹的判断会有差异。本期 AI 感质量分均值为 3.99，解读时: Reviewers differ on what counts as a machine trace. The mean AI-tells quality score this issue is 3.99; keep that subjectivity in mind when reading it.

故事梗概：「1979 年的北京什刹海，现代社畜猝死穿越，成了寄居二叔家、随时会被: Logline: “Shichahai, Beijing, 1979. A modern-day office drone drops dead, transmigrates, and becomes an orphan lodging in his second uncle's house — a ‘mangliu’ drifter with no papers, liable to be sent back at any moment.”
第一章：什刹海的狼: Chapter one: the wolf of Shichahai
穿越者在盛夏的荷花市场边醒来，饿得眼前发黑，随即面对街道办的遣返通牒与二叔一家的: The transmigrator wakes at the height of summer beside the lotus market, faint with hunger, and walks straight into a repatriation notice from the street committee and his second uncle's family squatting on his property. Three scenes:
（生理 / 年代感）：醒来先感到饿。用触觉和嗅觉写淤泥、鱼腥和汗臭，避免用上帝视: (physical / period feel): hunger comes first. Silt, fish stink and sweat are written through touch and smell — no god's-eye exposition of the backdrop.
（冲突 / 处境）：街道办上门，「盲流」身份随时可能被送走。要求通过对话和邻里围: (conflict / predicament): the street committee comes knocking — as a ‘mangliu’ he could be sent away at any time. The pressure of the era has to come through dialogue and the watching neighbours.
（人物 / 反差）：二叔林德柱一家占着正房，主角必须在示弱与反击之间做选择。: (character / contrast): his second uncle Lin Dezhu's family occupies the main rooms, and the protagonist must choose between playing weak and striking back.
：他想起前世读过的小说，在这里触发「文抄公」金手指。多个模型把这个转折写得很生硬: : he remembers the novels he read in his previous life, and this is where the “copyist” cheat power triggers. Several models wrote the turn very stiffly.
